episodeTitle.en: Build better products with continuous product discovery | Teresa Torres
episodeTitle.zh: 通过持续产品探索打造更优质产品 | 特蕾莎·托雷斯

guestBioOfficial.en: Teresa Torres is an internationally acclaimed author, speaker, and coach. She teaches a structured and sustainable system for continuous discovery that helps product teams infuse their daily product decisions with customer input. She’s coached hundreds of teams at companies of all sizes, from early-stage startups to global enterprises, in a variety of industries. She has taught over 11,000 product people discovery skills through the Product Talk Academy and hundreds through her coaching practice, and is the author of Continuous Discovery Habits.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 特蕾莎·托雷斯（Teresa Torres）是国际知名的作家、演讲者和教练。她教授了一套结构化且可持续的持续探索体系，帮助产品团队将客户反馈融入日常产品决策。她曾为各种规模的公司（从初创企业到全球企业）数百个团队提供指导，涉及多个行业。通过Product Talk Academy，她已为11,000多名产品人员传授探索技能，并通过教练实践帮助数百人提升技能。她是《持续探索习惯》一书的作者。

title.en: Build better products with continuous product discovery | Teresa Torres
title.zh: 通过持续产品探索打造更优质产品 | 特蕾莎·托雷斯

summary.en: Teresa makes the case for continuous discovery: talking to customers every week and mapping opportunities and solutions with opportunity solution trees. She explains why discovery is a habit, not a one-off research phase, and how it keeps teams connected to real customer problems between releases. The episode is a practical, grounding guide to the product discovery practice every team can adopt.
summary.zh: Teresa 论证了“持续发现”的必要性：每周与客户交谈，并用“机会—解决方案树（opportunity solution trees）”来梳理机会与方案。她解释了为什么发现是一种习惯、而非一次性的研究阶段，以及它如何让团队在版本之间始终与真实的客户问题保持连接。本期是一份务实、扎根的指南，关于每支团队都能采纳的产品发现实践。
